scenes.name: Hook
scenes.line: Kya diabetes mein hum kela aur aam kha sakte hain?
scenes.visual: Punch-in 115%. Banana + mango icons pop in beside the question.
scenes.graphic: Captions from frame 1. Question mark pulses once.
scenes.sfx: Soft pop on each fruit icon

scenes.name: Tease
scenes.line: Iska answer aapko surprise kar dega.
scenes.visual: Back to 100%. Lower third slides up.
scenes.graphic: Name card: Dr. Sachi Tandon / Diabetologist · MD Naturopathy · Nutrition Expert

scenes.name: Why fruits
scenes.line: Humare shareer ko kuch aise tatvon ki bahut zyada zaroorat hoti hai, jo humein instant energy dete hain.
scenes.visual: Jump cut at the mid-sentence pause, 100% → 115%.
scenes.graphic: Energy icon card (lightning) pops in on 'instant energy'.

scenes.name: Fructose
scenes.line: Jaise ki fructose, jo humare banana ya phir aur fruits mein hota hai.
scenes.visual: Rounded card in lower half, speaker stays visible.
scenes.graphic: Cream card: 'FRUCTOSE = fruit ki natural sugar' with banana illustration.

scenes.name: Micronutrients
scenes.line: Aur usme kuch aise poshak tatva, yaani nutrition hota hai, jinko hum micronutrients kehte hain.
scenes.graphic: Three chips pop in one by one: VITAMINS · MINERALS · FIBRE

scenes.name: Absorption
scenes.line: Agar woh humari body mein prachur matra mein nahi hain, to hum jo bhi intake karte hain, uska absorption proper nahi hota.
scenes.visual: Jump cut 115% → 100% at 'to hum jo bhi'.

scenes.name: Key factor
scenes.line: To yahan par key factor hai: portion control.
scenes.visual: FULL-SCREEN title on deep forest for ~1.2 s, then back to speaker.
scenes.graphic: 'KEY FACTOR' in serif italic, 'PORTION CONTROL' huge in turmeric.

scenes.name: Don't
scenes.line: Agar aap chaar banana ek saath kha lete hain, ya bada mango ek saath kha lete hain, to woh aapko nuksaan kar sakte hain.
scenes.graphic: ❌ cards in coral: '4 kele ek saath' and '1 bada aam ek saath'

scenes.name: Do
scenes.line: Lekin agar aap usko short portion mein khate hain, juice nahi banate, aur fibre ke saath khate hain…
scenes.graphic: ✅ icon list pops in one by one: CHHOTA PORTION · JUICE NAHI · FIBRE KE SAATH

scenes.name: Verdict
scenes.line: …to fruits bure nahi hain, fruits achhe hain. Unko zaroor include kariye.
scenes.graphic: 'Fruits bure nahi, ACHHE hain' ✅ stamp on 'achhe'.

scenes.name: Intro
scenes.line: Main hoon Dr. Sachi Tandon, diabetologist, MD Naturopathy and nutritional expert.
scenes.graphic: Name card again, larger, with credentials listed.

scenes.name: CTA + end card
scenes.line: Agar aap diabetes ke liye customised meal plan chahte hain, to Sachi Naturopathy se sampark kariye, immediately.
scenes.graphic: End card on deep forest: 'SACHI NATUROPATHY' in turmeric + 'Customised diabetes meal plans'.
